sources.title: Issued building permits
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Vancouver; retain dataset identifier, query, vintage and retrieval hash.
sources.update_frequency: daily for current year; prior years static
sources.notes: Permit issuance, elapsed days and applicant-estimated project value provide a transparent activity proxy from 2017 onward. They do not measure realized spend, labour hours, construction progress or AI use. Personal and precise-location fields are excluded from the processed artifact.

sources.title: Building Permits - Cleared Permits
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Toronto; retain resource identifier, query, vintage and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Cleared permits provide application, issue and completion dates plus estimated construction cost. Milestones are useful administrative proxies but do not establish physical progress, realized expenditure, labour hours or AI use.

sources.title: Permis de construction, transformation et démolition
sources.licence_note: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; retain resource identifier, query, vintage and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Permit application and issuance dates plus work descriptions support a disclosed activity proxy. The public dataset has no construction value, completion date, realized expenditure, labour hours or AI-use field.

sources.title: Building construction price indexes, by type of building and division
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 18-10-0289-01; 2023=100; data can be revised in later releases. Calgary and Edmonton support the Alberta pilot.

sources.title: Employee wages by occupation, annual
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 14-10-0417-01. Quality symbols and NOC vintage must be retained.

sources.title: Labour force characteristics by occupation, annual
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 14-10-0416-01. The public table stops at broad NOC groups and cannot directly denominator five-digit trades. It is retained for later broad-group benchmarking; preserve LFS sampling-quality symbols and the thousands-of-persons unit.

sources.title: Occupation unit group by labour force status, highest level of education, age and gender
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 98-10-0449-01, 2021 Census 25% sample. Selected WDS coordinates retrieve employed persons for six NOC 2021 unit groups across all 13 provinces and territories without downloading the 1.8 GB full cube. Counts use random rounding and the May 2-8, 2021 reference week.

sources.title: Job vacancies and average offered hourly wage by occupation (unit group), quarterly, unadjusted for seasonality
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 14-10-0444-01. Offered wages are not realized wages; quality indicators are analytically material.

sources.title: Supply and use tables, summary level, provincial and territorial
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 36-10-0438-01. Lag means it describes industry structure, not current utilization.

sources.title: Alberta Major Projects inventory
sources.licence_note: Publicly accessible government inventory; redistribution terms require confirmation before publishing a raw extract.
sources.notes: Inventory threshold is $5M. Costs, dates and stages can be estimated and must be corroborated for material AI projects. Export requires a session form POST and a source-specific adapter.

sources.title: British Columbia Major Projects Inventory feature layer
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence – British Columbia; retain provincial attribution and source link.
sources.notes: Official ArcGIS feature layer with 648 records at retrieval. Feature LAST_UPDATE values report 2024-12-01 even though the public program page describes Q3 2025 as the final inventory report. Treat this layer as historical and preserve the vintage discrepancy. Estimated cost is published in millions of Canadian dollars.

sources.title: Ontario Builds: key infrastructure projects
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence – Ontario; retain source attribution and licence notice.
sources.notes: Publisher describes the dataset as a sample of key infrastructure projects, not a complete capital plan. The current English all-project CSV has 5,935 rows. Zero estimated-budget values are treated as unavailable, never as zero project cost. The source does not publish a project identifier, so the adapter derives a deterministic vintage-record hash.

sources.title: Quebec public infrastructure project dashboard
sources.publisher: Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor du Québec
sources.licence_note: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 through Données Québec; attribute the Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor and dataset.
sources.notes: Current dashboard contains 649 PQI projects of $20 million or more. Data before November 2020 covered projects of $50 million or more. Published total cost and contribution values are in millions of Canadian dollars; blanks remain missing.

sources.title: Quebec infrastructure project dashboard field descriptions
sources.publisher: Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor du Québec
sources.licence_note: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 through Données Québec; attribute the Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor and dataset.
sources.notes: The document defines suivi_modifications as the presentation of changes authorized during the project lifecycle and their effective dates. Its own publication date is not encoded; the as-of date aligns it to the current dashboard resource used by AIIO.

sources.title: Quebec infrastructure dashboard CKAN resource catalog
sources.publisher: Données Québec and Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor du Québec
sources.licence_note: Public CKAN catalog metadata for a CC BY 4.0 dataset; downstream files retain the source dataset attribution.
sources.notes: The package catalog enumerates 69 official CSV dashboard vintages from 2020-05-19 through 2026-08-20 plus spreadsheet counterparts and the field dictionary. The source dataset states that the reporting threshold changed from $50 million to $20 million in November 2020.

sources.title: Alberta Major Projects methodology
sources.licence_note: Public government web page; cite directly.
sources.notes: Defines $5M threshold, location convention, estimated cost limitations, timing assumptions and project stages.

sources.title: Large Load Projects
sources.licence_note: Public AESO web material; cite source and linked project-list vintage.
sources.notes: Retrieved and hashed by the generic HTML adapter. Connection requests are not committed load. Preserve queue stage, contract status and linked project-list date.

sources.title: AESO Update on Data Centres, September 2025
sources.licence_note: Public AESO PDF; cite the publication, page and table or chart locator.
sources.notes: Reports cumulative requested data-centre load and requested energization profiles. Requests are not contracts, forecasts or realized demand.

sources.title: AESO Announces Interim Approach to Large Load Connections
sources.licence_note: Public AESO web material; cite directly and retain the retrieved page hash.
sources.notes: Defines the 1,200 MW interim limit and states that the Phase 1 approach required no new transmission reinforcements or upgrades. The statement is not transferable to larger or differently located loads.

sources.title: 2026 Long-Term Outlook input, assumptions and scenarios
sources.licence_note: Public AESO engagement material; linked files retain their own terms and versions.
sources.notes: This is an input/scenario consultation, not the final 2026 forecast. It explicitly identifies data-centre uncertainty.

sources.title: 2026 Annual Planning Outlook Data Tables
sources.licence_note: Public IESO planning workbook; cite the workbook vintage, worksheet and cell or table locator.
sources.notes: The May 14, 2026 revision corrects low-demand values in Figures 1 and 2. Scenario demand, energy need and capacity need are planning forecasts, not realized quantities. Retain the scenario label and publication correction date.

sources.title: 2026 Annual Planning Outlook: Demand Forecast Module
sources.geography: Ontario electricity system and IESO zones
sources.licence_note: Public IESO PDF; cite the publication, page and section locator.
sources.notes: Documents reference, high- and low-demand scenarios and a distinct commercial data-centre sub-sector. Project interest, scenario load, forecast energy and realized demand are not interchangeable.

sources.title: 2025 Integrated Resource Plan summary
sources.licence_note: Public BC Hydro web material; cite directly and retain the retrieved page hash.
sources.notes: Summary records proposed energy acquisitions, generation upgrades and named transmission actions. It is not a substitute for the BCUC-filed application, load forecast tables or project-specific transmission studies.

sources.title: État d’avancement 2025 du Plan d’approvisionnement 2023-2032
sources.publisher: Hydro-Québec Distribution via Régie de l’énergie
sources.licence_note: Public regulatory filing; cite the document, table and page locator.
sources.notes: Provides annual electricity-sales and winter-peak forecasts through 2035 with sector and uncertainty tables. Forecast sales, energy requirements, peak requirements and supply balances are distinct quantities.

sources.title: A new rate for data centres and a rate adjustment for blockchains
sources.licence_note: Public Hydro-Québec announcement; cite directly and retain the retrieved page hash.
sources.notes: Reports nearly 200 MW of current sector peak consumption and an approximately 1,000 MW 2035 outlook. The proposed tariff remains subject to regulatory approval; the forecast is not a connection commitment or transmission requirement.

sources.title: Apprenticeship and Industry Training data and research library
sources.licence_note: Public government reports; record the terms and vintage of each linked report.
sources.notes: Catalogue includes the 2024-25 Registrar report and statistical overview, program surveys and occupational outlook.

sources.title: Investment in Building Construction
sources.geography: Canada, provinces, territories and selected census metropolitan areas
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain table vintage, product number and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Measures residential and non-residential building investment. It is a regional activity/control series, not a project outcome and not an AI-specific treatment measure; engineering construction is excluded.

sources.title: Procurement and contracting data
sources.geography: Canada with participating federal, provincial, municipal and broader public-sector notices
sources.licence_note: Public Government of Canada procurement data; preserve dataset-specific terms, dictionaries, identifiers and vintages.
sources.notes: Catalogues tender notices, award notices and PSPC contract history. Coverage and fields differ by publisher; award value alone does not supply a project estimate, change-order history or actual completion date.

sources.title: CanadaBuys tender notices, 2026-2027
sources.geography: Canada, federal tender notices; delivery regions are publisher labels rather than project CMAs
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Canada; retain the CanadaBuys data dictionary, fiscal-year label, retrieval time and response hash.
sources.notes: Current-fiscal-year federal tender notices. Publication and closing dates support procurement-timing diagnostics; the file does not report compliant bidder counts, independent estimates or physical project completion.

sources.title: CanadaBuys award notices, 2026-2027
sources.geography: Canada, federal award notices; delivery regions are publisher labels rather than project CMAs
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Canada; retain the CanadaBuys data dictionary, fiscal-year label, retrieval time and response hash.
sources.notes: Current-fiscal-year federal award notices. Award dates and reported contract amounts are useful candidate outcome fields, but do not establish an independent estimate, complete approved-change history or physical completion.

sources.title: CanadaBuys contract history, 2026-2027
sources.geography: Canada, PSPC contract history; delivery regions are publisher labels rather than project CMAs
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Canada; retain the CanadaBuys data dictionary, fiscal-year label, retrieval time and response hash.
sources.notes: Current-fiscal-year PSPC contract history. Contract and amendment rows can be linked for feasibility screening, but the file is not a physical-project ledger and does not provide a consistent estimate price basis or actual completion.

sources.title: Proactive Publication - Contracts
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Canada; publisher warns that reports are unaudited and provides no warranty of completeness.
sources.notes: Useful for federal award and amendment screening. It does not by itself identify comparable public works, original independent estimates, physical completion or data-centre construction exposure.

sources.title: General Building Permits
sources.licence_note: City of Edmonton open-data terms; retain Socrata dataset identifier, query, retrieval time and response hash.
sources.notes: Includes permit date, building/work type, job description and reported construction value. A permit is an intention/proxy, not realized construction spend, labour hours or completion. Text classification of data-centre permits would be inferred and require review.

sources.title: Procurement and Delivery of Selected Infrastructure Projects
sources.publisher: Office of the Auditor General of Ontario
sources.licence_note: Official public audit report; retain the report year, retrieval time, response hash and exact page locators. Copyright remains with the Office of the Auditor General of Ontario.
sources.update_frequency: one-time audit report with possible hosted revisions
sources.notes: Independent performance audit of three named Ontario infrastructure projects. Lakeridge Gardens and Highway 427 contain valuable estimate-to-latest-cost and planned-to-actual substantial-completion evidence, but price-basis dates, complete approved-change histories and a reusable outcome panel remain incomplete. Highway 427 final costs were under dispute at the audit date.

sources.title: Capital and repair expenditures, non-residential tangible assets, by industry and geography
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; attribution and table citation required.
sources.notes: Table 34-10-0035-01 reports annual capital and repair expenditures by NAICS and geography from 2006 onward, with actual, preliminary actual and intentions vintages. NAICS 518210 includes computing infrastructure providers, data processing, web hosting and related services, but also non-data-centre activities; the table must be screened for province, asset and expenditure-type coverage before it can be considered even a broad realized-spend proxy.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted
sources.geography: Canada; provinces and territories; selected cities and census metropolitan areas
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain table vintage, product number, geography and product-group labels, quality symbols and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Table 18-10-0004-01 supplies all-items and shelter price indexes. CPI is a household consumption price measure, not a construction-cost index and not an AI-attributable inflation estimate.

sources.title: Population estimates, quarterly
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain table vintage, product number, estimate type, quality symbols and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Table 17-10-0009-01 supplies quarterly provincial population estimates. Population growth is a demand and denominator control, not evidence of construction capacity or an AI effect.

sources.title: Employment and average weekly earnings for all employees by province and territory, monthly, seasonally adjusted
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain table vintage, product number, NAICS label, estimate definition, quality symbols and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Table 14-10-0223-01 supplies seasonally adjusted employment and average weekly earnings. The regional macro screen uses the industrial aggregate for broad wage pressure; it is separate from occupation-specific offered wages and is not a labour-shortage measure.

sources.title: CMHC housing starts in centres 10,000 and over, seasonally adjusted at annual rates, monthly
sources.publisher: Statistics Canada and Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation
sources.geography: Canada; provinces and territories; selected census metropolitan areas
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain CMHC source attribution, table vintage, geography, unit type, quality symbols and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Table 34-10-0156-01 supplies housing starts at seasonally adjusted annual rates. Starts are a residential construction-demand proxy, not housing affordability, worker accommodation capacity or AI-attributable pressure.

sources.title: Building permits, by type of structure and type of work
sources.geography: Canada; provinces and territories; selected census metropolitan areas and municipalities
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain table vintage, geography, structure and work-type labels, quality symbols and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Permit values are leading indicators of intended construction. The aggregate table does not expose project-level AI classification or realized construction work and cannot authorize treatment.

sources.title: Survey of Commercial and Institutional Energy Use, 2024 questionnaire
sources.publisher: Statistics Canada and Natural Resources Canada
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada public survey instrument; retain program number, questionnaire version and retrieval date.
sources.notes: The instrument collects data-centre type, computer-room floor area, critical IT load, design load, cooling and annual energy use. Confidential building-level responses are not publicly retrievable, and the instrument contains no realized construction-spend or labour-hour measure.

sources.title: Survey of Commercial and Institutional Energy Use: Commercial and institutional buildings, 2024
sources.publisher: Statistics Canada and Natural Resources Canada
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain survey program, reference year, table labels and release date.
sources.notes: The public release reports regional commercial and institutional building floor area, energy consumption and intensity. It does not publish data-centre-specific region-quarter construction activity or respondent microdata.

sources.title: Real property projects delivered within scope, on time and on budget, 2024-2025
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence - Canada; retain fiscal-year vintage, project identifiers, data dictionary and retrieval hash.
sources.update_frequency: annual public file from an underlying quarterly monitoring process
sources.notes: Project-level time, budget and scope status may support outcome diagnostics. The public file must be profiled for stable identifiers, geography, asset class, baseline vintages and whether ordinal status can be linked longitudinally.

sources.title: Employment by industry and census metropolitan area, annual
sources.licence_note: Statistics Canada Open Licence; retain table vintage, CMA, NAICS labels, quality symbols and retrieval hash.
sources.notes: Annual broad-industry employment is useful labour context but cannot identify data-centre construction labour hours, project onset or quarterly treatment dose.
